name: ictherm
_comment: IC-ThermBench S2-S5 as released: <dir>/input.mat (N,P,Z,Y,X; ch0 chiplet power, ch3 local thermal k from S3 on) and <dir>/output.mat (N,Z,Y,X temperature, K). MATLAB v7.3 (h5py order). Splits follow the benchmark's own index split (0.8 train+val, 0.9 of that train, no shuffle).
